# Aureco

> Aureco is a packaging company for fashion and clothing brands. It makes custom hang tags, woven and satin clothing labels, mailer bags, paper bags, drawstring bags, wrapping paper, stickers and thank you cards for fashion designers, clothing labels, jewellery boutiques and boutique retailers across India.

Site: https://aureco-website.vercel.app/
Based in: India. Ships across India.
Contact: aurecopackaging@gmail.com | +91 70414 97055 | https://www.instagram.com/aurecopackaging
Typical response time: within 24 hours.

## What Aureco makes

- **Custom hang tags**: printed hang tags for clothing brands, including plantable seed paper.
- **Thank you cards**: branded cards on textured or uncoated stock.
- **Wrapping paper and stickers**: custom printed paper with matching branded stickers, made as one set.
- **Cotton tote bags**: reusable printed canvas totes for retail and events.
- **Flap bags**: paper mailer bags with a branded fold-over flap.
- **Drawstring bags**: cotton and jute bags for jewellery and accessories.
- **Clothing labels**: woven, satin and printed cotton labels sewn inside garments.
- **Waterproof kraft mailers**: durable mailer bags for shipping garments.
- **Paper shopping bags**: custom printed bags for retail counters and pop-ups.
- **Eco boxes**: recyclable rigid boxes for gifting and premium orders.

## Who Aureco serves

Fashion designers, clothing brands and labels, jewellery boutiques, and boutique retailers. Small batch friendly, so new and independent labels are a core customer, not an exception.

## Materials and sustainability

Kraft and recycled paper, plantable seed paper, textured and uncoated card stock, cotton, jute and canvas for bags, and woven, satin and printed cotton for labels. Finishes include deboss, foil and spot printing. Most products are recyclable, reusable or plantable.

## Pricing

Aureco quotes per job rather than publishing a rate card. Price depends on product, material, size, print method and quantity, and per unit cost drops as quantity rises. Minimum order quantity varies by product: woven labels and printed hang tags start lower than custom printed bags and boxes, which need tooling and print setup.

To get a real number, send the product, the rough quantity and the deadline to aurecopackaging@gmail.com or via the enquiry form at https://aureco-website.vercel.app/#contact
